KPI_1.name: New Customer and Expansion Opportunity ACV
KPI_1.description: Total Annual Contract Value for closed won new customer and expansion opportunities with positive ACV values.

KPI_2.name: S1+ Pipeline Coverage
KPI_2.description: Total pipeline ACV for S1+ stage opportunities excluding mode deployment type, used for coverage analysis.

KPI_3.name: Booking ACV vs Target Performance
KPI_3.description: Target booking ACV for new customer and expansion opportunities by geographic region, excluding global segment.

KPI_4.name: S1 Pipeline Creation for New Customers and Expansions
KPI_4.description: Total S1 starting ACV for new customer and expansion opportunities with positive values.

KPI_5.name: Pipeline Creation vs Target Achievement
KPI_5.description: Actual ACV created for new customer and expansion opportunities, excluding mode deployment type.

KPI_6.name: S0 Pipeline Creation for New Customers and Expansions
KPI_6.description: Total S0 starting ACV for new customer and expansion opportunities with positive values.

KPI_7.name: M1 Pipeline Creation for New Customers and Expansions
KPI_7.description: Total M1 starting ACV for new customer and expansion opportunities.

KPI_8.name: S3 Pipeline Creation for New Customers and Expansions
KPI_8.description: Total S3 starting ACV for new customer and expansion opportunities with positive values.

KPI_9.name: MQL Generation Excluding Mode Sources
KPI_9.description: Total Marketing Qualified Leads count excluding mode-related sources.

KPI_10.name: S1 Opportunity Creation Count for New Customers and Expansions
KPI_10.description: Count of S1 stage opportunities created for new customer and expansion business.

attributes: Opportunity Type, Booking Target Geo (by BT RegSeg), Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Source MQL Classification, Creation Target Geo
goal: Monitor and optimize the sales pipeline performance to drive revenue growth and achieve quarterly booking targets.
user_context: CMO-level executives and senior marketing leaders use this dashboard during quarterly business reviews and monthly pipeline assessments to comprehensively analyze the entire marketing and sales funnel from lead generation through revenue booking, starting with MQL creation and website traffic analysis, then drilling into opportunity stage progression and conversion rates across the full sales cycle (M1→S0→S1→S3→S7), examining pipeline coverage against targets for current and future quarters, analyzing lead source effectiveness and campaign performance, monitoring trial-to-conversion metrics for product-led growth, and ultimately assessing booking performance against targets - requiring them to navigate between high-level KPI summaries and detailed breakdowns by geography, segment, opportunity type, and time periods to identify bottlenecks, optimize resource allocation, and make strategic decisions about marketing spend and sales process improvements.
